basic_info.description: Significant Price Reduction - Rare Development Opportunity in SOMA! This fully vacant multi-family property, zoned Residential Enclave Mixed (RED-MX), offers investors and developers an incredible chance to unlock value through mixed-use residential development or adaptive reuse in one of San Francisco's most connected neighborhoods. With zoning incentives including a 45 ft height limit, no front set-back, and no density restrictions within permitted height/bulk, the site is primed for streamlined vertical development. The current layout includes two rear studio-style units and a flexible front space, ideal for live/work, creative use, or rental income while planning for future build-out. Don't miss this outstanding opportunity at a newly reduced price, combining location, zoning advantages, and long-term potential in the heart of SOMA and the Transit Center District.
